sources.snippet: Model Overview qqWen-1.5B-SFT is a 1.5-billion parameter language model specifically designed for advanced reasoning and code generation in the Q programming language. Built upon the robust Qwen 2.5 architecture, this model has undergone a comprehensive two-stage training process: pretraining and supervised fine-tuning (SFT), for the Q programming language.
